# Validate inputs
    if not all(isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2-dimensional")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
    if not (np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() and np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() and np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all()):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be finite")
    if logp_with_result.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Future horizon must be at least 1")
    if not ((logp_with_result <= 0).all() and (logp_call_only <= 0).all() and (logp_no_call <= 0).all()):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.floating)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    h = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(h)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    L_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_call = -np.sum(logp_call_only * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_no = -np.sum(logp_no_call * norm_weights, axis=1)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no, L_call)
    margins = L_minus - L_with
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    return keep, margins
